title: ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT~ESO Extremely Large Telescope
focus: 39 m 分段主鏡、五鏡光學、M4 自適應薄殼、M5 傾斜修正與分段共相的誤差預算~Error budgets for the 39 m segmented primary, five-mirror optics, M4 adaptive shells, M5 tip-tilt and segment phasing
summary: 以 Cerro Armazones 上的 39 m ELT 為對象，從繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度出發，拆解五鏡設計、798 片六角鏡段的 133 種段型與 8 nm 拋光、六片 1.95 mm 薄殼組成的 M4、約 9000 個邊緣感測器的共相控制、M4／M5 的頻段分工，以及分段重鍍與初光驗收的工程邏輯。~Taking the 39 m ELT on Cerro Armazones, start from the diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity, then work through the five-mirror design, the 133 segment types and 8 nm polish of 798 hexagonal segments, the M4 built from six 1.95 mm shells, phasing control with about 9000 edge sensors, the M4/M5 frequency split, and the engineering logic of segment recoating and first-light acceptance.

units.anchor: 39 m 分段主鏡口徑~39 m segmented aperture
units.title: 39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度~Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture
units.mechanism: ELT 的科學理由不只是集光：當自適應光學把影像修正到接近繞射極限時，點源影像的角大小隨 λ/D 縮小，背景只在更小的立體角內與訊號競爭，因此在背景主導的條件下，達到相同訊雜比所需時間按 D⁴ 縮短，其中 D² 來自集光、另一個 D² 來自影像面積縮小。這也意味著 ELT 的價值高度依賴自適應光學與分段共相：若影像只有視寧度寬度，就只剩 D² 的集光收益。主鏡外徑 39 m、中央遮擋約 11 m，集光面積接近 1000 m²。~The scientific case for the ELT is not only light grasp: once adaptive optics brings images close to the diffraction limit, a point-source image shrinks as λ/D and the background competes with the signal over a much smaller solid angle, so in the background-limited regime the time to reach a given signal-to-noise ratio falls as D⁴, with D² from collecting area and another D² from the smaller image. It follows that the ELT's value depends heavily on adaptive optics and segment phasing: with seeing-limited images only the D² gain from area remains. The primary is 39 m across with a central obstruction of about 11 m, giving a collecting area close to 1000 m².
units.model: K 波段（2.2 µm）繞射極限 1.22λ/D：D = 39 m 時約 14.2 mas，8.2 m 時約 67.5 mas。背景主導且繞射受限時，所需時間比 ≈ (39/8.2)⁴ ≈ 512；只有集光時為 (39/8.2)² ≈ 22.6。以外半徑 18.5 m、內半徑 5.5 m 估算面積 π(18.5² − 5.5²) ≈ 980 m²，遮擋佔外圓面積約 (11.1/39)² ≈ 8%。~The K-band (2.2 µm) diffraction limit 1.22λ/D is about 14.2 mas for D = 39 m and 67.5 mas for 8.2 m. Background-limited and diffraction-limited, the time ratio is ≈ (39/8.2)⁴ ≈ 512, versus (39/8.2)² ≈ 22.6 from area alone. With outer radius 18.5 m and inner radius 5.5 m the area is π(18.5² − 5.5²) ≈ 980 m², and the obstruction covers about (11.1/39)² ≈ 8% of the outer disc.
units.verify: 以觀測模擬器把相同目標在不同 Strehl 與視寧度下的點擴散函數、天光背景與偵測器雜訊代入訊雜比方程，畫出所需時間對 Strehl 的曲線，確認 D⁴ 收益只在高 Strehl 區間成立；並把結果與單元望遠鏡的實測曝光時間計算器比較，作為科學需求與自適應光學需求的連結。~Feed the point-spread function, sky background and detector noise for the same target at different Strehl ratios and seeing into the signal-to-noise equation with an observation simulator, plot required time versus Strehl and confirm that the D⁴ gain holds only at high Strehl; compare against exposure-time calculators of existing 8 m telescopes to link science requirements with adaptive-optics requirements.
units.failure: 若專案只追求主鏡面積而低估共相與自適應光學的難度，完成的望遠鏡會變成昂貴的視寧度受限光桶，在背景主導的紅外觀測中只得到約 23 倍而非數百倍的時間收益。~If a project chases mirror area while underestimating phasing and adaptive optics, the finished telescope becomes an expensive seeing-limited light bucket that gains only about 23 times, not hundreds of times, in background-limited infrared observing time.
units.misconception: 望遠鏡的靈敏度只和集光面積成正比。~Telescope sensitivity scales only with collecting area.

units.anchor: M1 至 M5 五鏡光路~M1 to M5 five-mirror train
units.title: 五鏡設計：三鏡消像散加兩面平面控制鏡~Five-mirror design: a three-mirror anastigmat plus two flat control mirrors
units.mechanism: ELT 的光學由五面鏡組成：M1 為曲率半徑約 68.7 m 的 39 m 分段凹面橢球鏡，M2 為 4.2 m 凸面薄彎月鏡，M3 為 3.8 m 主動凹面鏡，三者構成在較大視場內同時校正球差、彗差與像散的三鏡消像散系統。M4 是約 2.4 m 的平面自適應鏡，修正大氣湍流與望遠鏡振動；M5 是約 2.6 m × 2.1 m 的平面橢圓鏡，負責數 Hz 以下的影像穩定並把光送到 Nasmyth 平台。把自適應鏡做在望遠鏡內，所有儀器都能共用修正，但也代表每多一面鏡就多一次反射損失與熱發射。~ELT optics consist of five mirrors: M1 is a 39 m segmented concave ellipsoid with a radius of curvature of about 68.7 m, M2 a 4.2 m convex thin meniscus and M3 a 3.8 m active concave mirror, together forming a three-mirror anastigmat that corrects spherical aberration, coma and astigmatism over a wide field. M4 is a flat adaptive mirror about 2.4 m across that corrects atmospheric turbulence and telescope vibration; M5 is a flat elliptical mirror of about 2.6 m × 2.1 m that stabilises the image below a few hertz and sends the beam to the Nasmyth platforms. Building the adaptive mirror into the telescope lets every instrument share the correction, but each extra mirror adds a reflection loss and thermal emission.
units.model: 五次反射的通量為 R⁵：每面 R = 0.95（假設）時 0.95⁵ ≈ 0.774，R = 0.97 時 ≈ 0.859，差異相當於 11% 的曝光時間。M1 的曲率半徑 68.7 m 對應焦距約 34.4 m，主鏡邊緣的光線傾角 r/R = 18.5/68.7 ≈ 0.27 rad（約 15°），顯示 M1 是非常快的分段鏡面。~Five reflections give a throughput of R⁵: 0.95⁵ ≈ 0.774 with R = 0.95 per mirror (assumption) and ≈ 0.859 with R = 0.97, a difference worth 11% of exposure time. M1's 68.7 m radius of curvature gives a focal length of about 34.4 m, and the surface slope at the rim r/R = 18.5/68.7 ≈ 0.27 rad (about 15°) shows how fast the segmented primary is.
units.verify: 以光學設計軟體建立五鏡模型，對每面鏡的位移與傾斜計算 Zernike 靈敏度矩陣，確認 M2 與 M3 的主動定位範圍足以涵蓋重力與溫度變形；在整合階段以內部光源與波前感測器量測系統像差，並以分項反射率乘積與實測天文通量比較。~Build the five-mirror model in optical-design software and compute the Zernike sensitivity matrix for displacement and tilt of each mirror, confirming that the active positioning ranges of M2 and M3 cover gravity and thermal deformation; during integration measure system aberrations with internal sources and wavefront sensors, and compare the product of individual reflectances with measured on-sky throughput.
units.failure: M2 若因重力或溫度產生微小橫移，會在整個視場引入彗差，若誤由 M4 吸收，M4 的行程被常態偏置占用而失去修正湍流的餘量；M5 的低頻任務若交給 M4，也會造成同樣的行程飽和。~A small lateral shift of M2 from gravity or temperature introduces coma across the field; if M4 absorbs it, part of M4's stroke is permanently biased and its margin for turbulence shrinks, and handing M5's low-frequency job to M4 saturates its stroke in the same way.
units.misconception: 鏡子越少越好，所以五鏡設計只是為了配合建築空間。~Fewer mirrors are always better, so the five-mirror design only fits the building.

units.anchor: 1.45 m 六角形 Zerodur 鏡段~1.45 m hexagonal Zerodur segment
units.title: M1 鏡段：133 種段型、離軸非球面與 8 nm 拋光~M1 segments: 133 types, off-axis aspheres and an 8 nm polish
units.mechanism: M1 由 798 片約 1.45 m、厚約 5 cm 的六角形 Zerodur 鏡段組成，分成六個相同的扇區，每扇區 133 片各不相同，另備第七組 133 片供輪替重鍍，共 931 片。因為 M1 是接近拋物面的橢球，每個鏡段都是主鏡不同位置的離軸片，越外圈的鏡段非球面偏離越大。SCHOTT 製作鏡坯，Safran Reosc 研磨、拋光、切邊並整合，表面不規則度約 8 nm 以內。每片背後有 27 點 whiffletree 支撐、9 個翹曲調整器修正低階面形，以及 3 個定位致動器控制活塞與傾斜。~M1 is made of 798 hexagonal Zerodur segments about 1.45 m across and 5 cm thick, arranged in six identical sectors of 133 different segments each, plus a seventh set of 133 for rotation through recoating, 931 in all. Because M1 is a near-paraboloidal ellipsoid, each segment is an off-axis piece of the parent mirror, and the outer rings depart more from a sphere. SCHOTT makes the blanks and Safran Reosc grinds, polishes, cuts and integrates them, holding surface irregularities to about 8 nm. Behind each segment sit a 27-point whiffletree support, 9 warping-harness actuators for low-order figure and 3 position actuators controlling piston and tilt.
units.model: 近似拋物面時，鏡面與同頂點曲率球面的差 Δz ≈ r⁴/(8R³)：R = 68.7 m，r = 10 m 時約 3.9 mm，r = 18.5 m 時約 45 mm，以 r⁴ 增長，所以不同半徑的鏡段必須拋成不同的離軸非球面。單片鏡段本身的矢高約 r²/(2R) = 0.725²/137.4 ≈ 3.8 mm。~For a near-paraboloid, the departure from the vertex sphere is Δz ≈ r⁴/(8R³): with R = 68.7 m it is about 3.9 mm at r = 10 m and about 45 mm at r = 18.5 m, growing as r⁴, so segments at different radii must be polished as different off-axis aspheres. A single segment's own sag is about r²/(2R) = 0.725²/137.4 ≈ 3.8 mm.
units.verify: 每片鏡段在拋光後以干涉儀配合電腦全像或零位光學量測面形，扣除翹曲調整器可修正的低階項後檢查殘差；再以座標量測確認六角外形與邊緣切削尺寸，並在支撐單元上重測以確認 whiffletree 與黏結墊沒有引入印記。~After polishing, measure each segment's figure interferometrically with a computer-generated hologram or null optic, remove the low-order terms the warping harness can correct and inspect the residual; then confirm hexagonal outline and edge dimensions with coordinate metrology, and remeasure on the support assembly to make sure the whiffletree and bonded pads leave no print-through.
units.failure: 若某一段型的離軸參數在拋光時用錯半徑位置，鏡段面形自身合格，但裝上後在該位置產生大量像散，翹曲調整器的行程不夠修正，只能重拋；黏結墊收縮不均也會在 27 點支撐處留下規則的面形印記。~If a segment type is polished with the off-axis parameters of the wrong radius, it passes on its own but produces large astigmatism once installed, beyond the warping-harness range, and must be repolished; uneven shrinkage of bonded pads also leaves a regular figure print at the 27 support points.
units.misconception: 798 片六角鏡段形狀都一樣，可以任意互換位置。~All 798 hexagonal segments have the same shape and can be swapped anywhere.

units.anchor: M4 六片薄殼與 SiC 參考體~M4 six shells and SiC reference body
units.title: M4 自適應鏡：薄殼、音圈陣列與更換策略~M4 adaptive mirror: thin shells, voice-coil array and exchange strategy
units.mechanism: M4 是約 2.4 m 的平面自適應鏡，由六片 60° 扇形 Zerodur 薄殼組成，每片從約 35 mm 的鏡坯磨薄到 1.95 mm，厚度均勻度優於 15 µm。薄殼漂浮在 2.7 m 碳化矽參考結構前約 90 µm 處，背後超過 5000 個音圈致動器以最高每秒 1000 次的速率改變形狀，位置則以每秒 70,000 次量測，行程可達 50 µm。SCHOTT 供應鏡坯，Safran Reosc 磨薄與拋光，AdOptica 聯盟製作殼體組件與支撐單元。由於薄殼也需定期重鍍，共製作 12 片薄殼，重鍍時可整組替換而不停機太久。~M4 is a flat adaptive mirror about 2.4 m across made of six 60° Zerodur shell petals, each thinned from a roughly 35 mm blank to 1.95 mm with thickness uniformity better than 15 µm. The shells float about 90 µm in front of a 2.7 m silicon-carbide reference structure, and more than 5000 voice-coil actuators reshape them up to 1000 times per second while position is sensed 70,000 times per second, with up to 50 µm of stroke. SCHOTT supplies the blanks, Safran Reosc thins and polishes them, and the AdOptica consortium builds the shell assemblies and support unit. Since the shells also need periodic recoating, 12 are made so that a full set can be swapped during recoating without long downtime.
units.model: 板的彎曲剛度 ∝ t³：從 35 mm 磨到 1.95 mm，剛度降為 (1.95/35)³ ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁴，約柔軟 5800 倍，才讓音圈的小力量就能推出數十微米形變。面積 π/4 × 2.4² ≈ 4.52 m² 分給 5000 個致動器，每個約 9.0×10⁻⁴ m²，間距約 30 mm，投影到 39 m 瞳面約 0.49 m。每次命令之間有約 70 次位置量測可用於內迴路。~Plate bending stiffness scales as t³: thinning from 35 mm to 1.95 mm reduces it to (1.95/35)³ ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁴, about 5800 times softer, which lets small voice-coil forces push tens of micrometres of deformation. Dividing π/4 × 2.4² ≈ 4.52 m² among 5000 actuators gives about 9.0×10⁻⁴ m² each, a pitch near 30 mm and about 0.49 m projected onto the 39 m pupil. About 70 position samples are available to the inner loop between successive commands.
units.verify: 以干涉儀量每片薄殼在參考體上的平面化殘差，確認低於 14 nm RMS；逐一推動致動器量影響函數並檢查失效或耦合異常的單元；以階躍命令量測穩定時間與頻寬，並在整合後以六片之間的接縫活塞差檢查分片控制的一致性。~Measure each shell's flattened residual on the reference body interferometrically and confirm it is below 14 nm RMS; poke each actuator to record influence functions and flag dead or abnormally coupled units; measure settling time and bandwidth with step commands, and after integration check the piston steps across the six petal seams for consistent petal control.
units.failure: 六片薄殼之間的接縫若控制不一致，會在瞳面形成扇形活塞誤差，即使每片各自平整，影像也出現花瓣狀的旁瓣；冷卻或電子機箱熱量若沒有移除，薄殼附近的局部湍流會抵消一部分修正。~If the six shells are not controlled consistently across their seams, sector-shaped piston errors appear in the pupil, and even with each shell flat the image shows petal-like sidelobes; heat from electronics that is not removed creates local turbulence near the shells that cancels part of the correction.
units.misconception: 自適應鏡越硬越好，因為剛性才能保持形狀。~An adaptive mirror should be as stiff as possible because stiffness holds shape.

units.anchor: 邊緣感測器與定位致動器~Edge sensors and position actuators
units.title: 分段共相：邊緣感測器、致動器與弱可觀測模態~Segment phasing: edge sensors, actuators and weakly observable modes
units.mechanism: 798 片鏡段必須在整個 39 m 範圍內對齊到數十奈米，否則 M1 會變成許多彼此不相干的小鏡子。相鄰鏡段的邊上裝有成對的邊緣感測器，量測彼此的高度差與間隙，精度為數奈米；控制器把約 9000 個感測器讀值反解成每片 3 個定位致動器的命令，致動器精度約 2 nm、行程 10 mm。邊緣感測器只量相對高度，因此整體活塞、整體傾斜與類似離焦的碗狀模態幾乎看不到，必須由望遠鏡的波前感測器或專用共相相機定期量測，並重設感測器的參考值。~The 798 segments must be aligned to tens of nanometres across the whole 39 m, or M1 becomes many mutually incoherent small mirrors. Pairs of edge sensors along adjacent edges measure relative height and gap to a few nanometres; the controller inverts about 9000 sensor readings into commands for the 3 position actuators of each segment, which have about 2 nm precision and 10 mm stroke. Edge sensors only see relative height, so global piston, global tilt and a defocus-like bowl mode are nearly invisible to them and must be measured periodically by the telescope's wavefront sensors or a dedicated phasing camera, which then resets the sensor reference values.
units.model: 六角拼接中共享邊數約為 3N 扣除邊界：模擬 804 片環形拼接得約 2268 條共享邊，每邊 2 對感測器約 4500 對，即約 9000 個感測器，與公開數字一致。鏡段活塞的面誤差 σ = 10 nm 時波前誤差 20 nm，Strehl = exp[−(2π×20/λ)²]：λ = 1.65 µm 時約 0.994，500 nm 時約 0.939。~In a hexagonal tiling the number of shared edges is about 3N minus the boundary: simulating an annulus of 804 segments gives about 2268 shared edges, and 2 sensor pairs per edge make about 4500 pairs, about 9000 sensors, matching the published figure. A segment piston surface error σ = 10 nm doubles to 20 nm of wavefront, and Strehl = exp[−(2π×20/λ)²] is about 0.994 at 1.65 µm and 0.939 at 500 nm.
units.verify: 以共相相機量測各鏡段的活塞與傾斜，與邊緣感測器推得的值比對，得到感測器偏移量；在不同仰角與溫度下重複，建立感測器零點對溫度與重力的模型；並以奇異值分解檢查控制矩陣中最小奇異值對應的模態，估算感測器雜訊在這些模態上的放大倍數。~Measure segment piston and tilt with the phasing camera and compare with values inferred from the edge sensors to obtain sensor offsets; repeat at different elevations and temperatures to model sensor zero points against temperature and gravity; and use singular-value decomposition to identify the modes with the smallest singular values in the control matrix and estimate how much sensor noise they amplify.
units.failure: 若感測器零點隨溫度漂移而沒有以共相相機重設，邊緣感測器迴路會忠實地把錯誤維持住，鏡段逐漸形成碗狀或鋸齒狀的活塞誤差；在可見光與近紅外短波，Strehl 會先受害，而長波仍看似正常，讓問題延遲被發現。~If sensor zero points drift with temperature and are not reset by the phasing camera, the edge-sensor loop faithfully holds the error, and the segments develop a bowl-shaped or sawtooth piston pattern; Strehl suffers first in the visible and short near-infrared while long wavelengths still look normal, delaying discovery.
units.misconception: 邊緣感測器夠精確，就能單獨決定整面主鏡的形狀。~Accurate edge sensors alone can determine the shape of the whole primary.

units.anchor: M5 傾斜鏡與 M4 頻段分工~M5 tip-tilt and M4 frequency split
units.title: 影像穩定預算：風振、結構振動與 M4／M5 分工~Image-stability budget: wind shake, structural vibration and the M4/M5 split
units.mechanism: ELT 的主結構與鏡面在風載、追蹤與機械振動下會讓影像移動，影像移動若不修正，即使波前其他部分完美也會把繞射極限的影像抹寬。M5 以大行程、低頻寬的傾斜修正吸收數 Hz 以下的風振與追蹤誤差；M4 以小行程、高頻寬的傾斜加上高階形狀修正處理較快的振動與湍流，並持續把平均傾斜卸載給 M5，避免 M4 行程飽和。工程上要分別為每個頻段估計干擾振幅，再乘上各迴路的抑制函數，最後把殘餘影像移動換算成 Strehl 損失。~Wind load, tracking and mechanical vibration make the ELT image move, and uncorrected image motion smears a diffraction-limited image even if the rest of the wavefront is perfect. M5 provides large-stroke, low-bandwidth tip-tilt to absorb wind shake and tracking errors below a few hertz; M4 adds small-stroke, high-bandwidth tip-tilt and high-order shape correction for faster vibration and turbulence, continuously offloading its average tilt to M5 so its stroke does not saturate. The engineering task is to estimate disturbance amplitude in each frequency band, multiply by the rejection function of each loop and convert the residual image motion into a Strehl loss.
units.model: 一階迴路在 f 遠低於交越頻率 f_c 時的殘差約為 f/f_c。風振 20 mas 在 0.3 Hz、M5 交越 3 Hz（假設）殘差約 2.0 mas；結構振動 3 mas 在 10 Hz、M4 傾斜迴路交越 50 Hz（假設）殘差約 0.6 mas，合計約 2.1 mas。K 波段 λ/D ≈ 11.6 mas，S_jitter ≈ 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ/(λ/D))²] ≈ 0.86。~A first-order loop leaves a residual of roughly f/f_c well below its crossover f_c. Wind shake of 20 mas at 0.3 Hz with an assumed 3 Hz M5 crossover leaves about 2.0 mas; structural vibration of 3 mas at 10 Hz with an assumed 50 Hz M4 tip-tilt crossover leaves about 0.6 mas, about 2.1 mas combined. With λ/D ≈ 11.6 mas in K band, S_jitter ≈ 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ/(λ/D))²] ≈ 0.86.
units.verify: 在結構上布置加速度計與風速計，記錄不同風速與方位下的影像移動功率譜；以自然星的快速傾斜感測器量閉迴路殘差，分頻段比較 M5 與 M4 各自的抑制效果，並檢查卸載迴路是否讓 M4 的平均傾斜保持在行程中央。~Instrument the structure with accelerometers and anemometers and record image-motion power spectra at different wind speeds and azimuths; measure closed-loop residuals with a fast natural-star tip-tilt sensor, compare M5 and M4 rejection band by band, and check that the offload loop keeps M4's average tilt near the centre of its stroke.
units.failure: 若某個結構共振恰好落在 M5 與 M4 迴路的交接頻段，兩個迴路都只有部分抑制，甚至互相放大，影像出現特定頻率的抖動；如果卸載迴路增益太低，強風下 M4 行程飽和，整個自適應光學系統開迴路。~If a structural resonance falls in the handover band between the M5 and M4 loops, both reject it only partially or even amplify it, and the image jitters at that frequency; if the offload gain is too low, M4 saturates in strong wind and the whole adaptive-optics system drops out of closed loop.
units.misconception: 只要自適應鏡夠快，望遠鏡結構振動就不需要另外管理。~If the adaptive mirror is fast enough, structural vibration needs no separate management.

units.anchor: 鏡段輪替重鍍與備用扇區~Segment rotation recoating and spare sector
units.title: Armazones 營運：鏡段輪替、重鍍節奏與可用率~Operations on Armazones: segment rotation, recoating cadence and availability
units.mechanism: ELT 位於海拔約 3000 m 的 Cerro Armazones，灰塵與高紫外輻射會逐漸降低鏡面反射率並增加散射。M1 的每片鏡段約每 18 個月重鍍一次，因此營運上是一條連續的生產線：每天卸下約兩片、送到山上的鍍膜設施清洗重鍍，再裝回並重新共相。第七組 133 片備用鏡段讓卸下的位置能立即補上已鍍好的鏡段，避免主鏡出現空洞。每次更換都會擾動邊緣感測器的參考值，所以交換流程必須和共相校正綁在一起。~The ELT sits at about 3000 m on Cerro Armazones, where dust and strong ultraviolet gradually lower reflectance and increase scatter. Each M1 segment is recoated roughly every 18 months, so operations run as a continuous production line: about two segments per day are removed, cleaned and recoated in the on-site coating facility, reinstalled and rephased. The seventh set of 133 spare segments lets a freshly coated segment fill each vacated position immediately, so the primary never has holes. Every exchange disturbs the edge-sensor references, so the exchange procedure must be tied to phasing calibration.
units.model: 798 片 ÷ 每天 2 片 ≈ 399 天，18 個月約 548 天，所以約 73% 的日子都有鏡段更換；一組 133 片備用鏡段相當於約 66 天的更換緩衝。若每片反射率每 18 個月因灰塵平均下降 2%（假設），輪替使整面主鏡維持在新鍍與 2% 衰減之間，平均損失約 1%。~798 segments ÷ 2 per day ≈ 399 days, against about 548 days in 18 months, so segments are exchanged on about 73% of days; a spare set of 133 segments is a buffer of about 66 exchange days. If dust lowers each segment's reflectance by 2% over 18 months (assumption), rotation keeps the primary between fresh and 2% degraded, an average loss of about 1%.
units.verify: 以攜帶式反射率計與散射計追蹤每片鏡段在不同服役時間的反射率，擬合衰減曲線並檢查是否與鏡段位置或風向相關；每次更換後記錄共相相機重新校正的時間與殘差，確認交換流程不會累積活塞誤差。~Track reflectance and scatter of each segment against time in service with portable reflectometers and scatterometers, fit the decay curve and check correlation with segment position or wind direction; after every exchange log the time and residual of the phasing-camera recalibration to confirm that the exchange process does not accumulate piston errors.
units.failure: 若鍍膜設施或吊裝設備停擺數週，輪替節奏中斷，最舊的鏡段反射率繼續下降，主鏡出現反射率不均的圖樣；若更換後沒有重做共相，就把新鏡段的活塞誤差帶進科學觀測。~If the coating plant or handling equipment stops for weeks, the rotation stalls, the oldest segments keep losing reflectance and the primary develops a patchy reflectance pattern; if phasing is not redone after an exchange, the new segment's piston error enters science observations.
units.misconception: 分段主鏡可以像單片主鏡一樣，幾年才一次整面重鍍。~A segmented primary can be recoated all at once every few years like a monolithic one.

units.anchor: 初光與第一代儀器~First light and first-generation instruments
units.title: 初光驗收：點擴散函數取樣與 Strehl 量測~First-light acceptance: PSF sampling and Strehl measurement
units.mechanism: 依 ESO 的時程，ELT 預計 2029 年進行首次測試觀測，2030 年 12 月交付第一批以科學儀器完成的觀測。第一代儀器包括近紅外成像儀 MICADO、積分場光譜儀 HARMONI 與中紅外儀器 METIS，並以 MORFEO 等自適應光學模組提供多共軛修正。驗收不能只看單一系統合格：必須在天上以點擴散函數量測 Strehl、共相殘差、影像穩定與通量，並與預算表逐項對照，才能決定哪些觀測模式可以交給使用者。~According to ESO's schedule, the ELT is planned to make its first test observations in 2029 and deliver the first observations with scientific instruments in December 2030. First-generation instruments include the near-infrared imager MICADO, the integral-field spectrograph HARMONI and the mid-infrared instrument METIS, with adaptive-optics modules such as MORFEO providing multi-conjugate correction. Acceptance cannot rest on individual subsystems passing: Strehl, phasing residual, image stability and throughput must be measured on sky from the point-spread function and compared item by item with the budget before deciding which observing modes can be released to users.
units.model: 要從影像量測 Strehl，像素至少需 Nyquist 取樣 λ/(2D)：K 波段為 2.2 µm/(2×39 m) ≈ 2.8×10⁻⁸ rad ≈ 5.8 mas，因此驗收相機需用 5.8 mas 以下的像素。若取樣不足，峰值被像素平均，量到的 Strehl 系統性偏低。~Measuring Strehl from images requires at least Nyquist sampling λ/(2D): in K band 2.2 µm/(2×39 m) ≈ 2.8×10⁻⁸ rad ≈ 5.8 mas, so the acceptance camera needs pixels below 5.8 mas. With undersampling the peak is averaged over a pixel and the measured Strehl is systematically low.
units.verify: 以 Nyquist 取樣的相機拍攝亮星，扣除背景後把影像峰值與同總通量、同瞳面形狀（含 11 m 遮擋與鏡段間隙）的理論繞射影像比較得到 Strehl；同時記錄邊緣感測器、M4／M5 迴路殘差與視寧度，讓每項誤差都有對應的獨立量測，最後形成交給儀器團隊的性能報告。~Image a bright star with a Nyquist-sampled camera, subtract background and compare the image peak with a theoretical diffraction image of the same total flux and pupil geometry, including the 11 m obstruction and segment gaps, to obtain Strehl; log edge sensors, M4/M5 loop residuals and seeing at the same time so every error term has an independent measurement, and assemble the performance report handed to instrument teams.
units.failure: 若理論點擴散函數忽略鏡段間隙與蜘蛛架，參考峰值被高估，量到的 Strehl 被低估，可能誤判共相失敗；反之若相機像素過大，又會誤以為是自適應光學不良，導致錯誤的調機方向。~If the theoretical PSF omits segment gaps and spiders, the reference peak is overestimated and the measured Strehl underestimated, which may be misread as a phasing failure; conversely, pixels that are too large make the adaptive optics look poor and send commissioning in the wrong direction.
units.misconception: 看到星像變小就代表望遠鏡已達設計 Strehl。~A visibly smaller star image proves the telescope meets its design Strehl.

example: K 波段影像品質預算練習：假設鏡段活塞的波前誤差 20 nm RMS、鏡段面形殘差 20 nm RMS、自適應光學殘差 150 nm RMS，平方和開根號為 √(20² + 20² + 150²) ≈ 153 nm；Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×153/2200)²] = exp(−0.191) ≈ 0.83。再乘上影像移動 2.1 mas 造成的 0.86，總 Strehl ≈ 0.71。若活塞誤差惡化到 80 nm，總和變為 √(80² + 20² + 150²) ≈ 171 nm，Strehl 降到約 0.79 × 0.86 ≈ 0.68；在 1.2 µm 同一組誤差給出 exp[−(2π×171/1200)²] ≈ 0.45（尚未計入抖動），說明短波長對共相更敏感。數值為教學假設，不代表 ELT 規格。~K-band image-quality budget exercise: assume 20 nm RMS wavefront from segment piston, 20 nm RMS segment figure residual and 150 nm RMS adaptive-optics residual. The root-sum-square is √(20² + 20² + 150²) ≈ 153 nm, and Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×153/2200)²] = exp(−0.191) ≈ 0.83. Multiplying by 0.86 from 2.1 mas of image motion gives a total Strehl ≈ 0.71. If piston worsens to 80 nm the sum becomes √(80² + 20² + 150²) ≈ 171 nm and Strehl falls to about 0.79 × 0.86 ≈ 0.68; at 1.2 µm the same errors give exp[−(2π×171/1200)²] ≈ 0.45 before jitter, showing that short wavelengths are more sensitive to phasing. Values are teaching assumptions, not ELT specifications.
history: ESO 理事會於 2006 年核准極大望遠鏡的詳細研究，2010 年選定 Cerro Armazones 為站址，2014 年起動工建設通往山頂的道路。2018 年 SCHOTT 澆鑄第一批六角形主鏡鏡段，圓頂與主結構也開始施工；2024 年首批 18 片 M1 鏡段運抵智利。依 ESO 公開時程，望遠鏡預計 2029 年首次測試觀測、2030 年 12 月以科學儀器開始觀測。~The ESO Council approved detailed studies of the Extremely Large Telescope in 2006, Cerro Armazones was chosen as the site in 2010, and construction of the summit road began in 2014. In 2018 SCHOTT cast the first hexagonal primary segments and work on the dome and main structure began; in 2024 the first 18 M1 segments arrived in Chile. According to ESO's public timeline, the telescope is planned to make first test observations in 2029 and begin observations with scientific instruments in December 2030.
